The '''EXVR-1 Guardian Grid''', commonly known as the '''Ion Defense Grid''', was a an intricate network of [[ion field generator]]s contained within a superstructure which could combine their ionic energy into a single ionic pulse capable of shutting down an enemy [[Starship/Legends|ship]].

The tunnel within [[Exovar's Emporium]] where the Ion Defense Grid was installed had the local nickname "[[Ion Alley]]."

==Behind the scenes==
The Ion Defense Grid was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].

It was mentioned as one of several defensive measures that was protecting Exovar's Emporium.
